presetHint.off: One drafting call; deterministic validators only. Fastest, lowest quality.
presetHint.economy: One drafting call with the protagonist's inner voice injected; the webnovel critic grades the result but does not rewrite.
presetHint.balanced: Beats grouped into scenes, one drafting call per scene with subtext packets, model critic, up to 2 surgical polish passes, hook sharpening.
presetHint.full: Model-planned scenes, scene-by-scene drafting with subtext packets, adversarial critic, up to 3 surgical polish passes, hook sharpening. Maximum quality; token cost is not a concern.

craft.gradeHint: Instant webnovel critic: AI tics, interiority, dialogue, pacing, sensory grounding, hook and payoff. No model call.
craft.noText: Nothing to grade — the chapter is empty.
craft.clean: No findings. The critic would accept this chapter.
craft.findings: {n} finding(s) — click one to jump to it
craft.hookSuggest: Soft ending. Rewrite the last two paragraphs as a {h} hook.

dim.authenticityHint: Reads like a living webnovel narrator, not generic literary AI
dim.voiceHint: The POV's personality is on every page
dim.interiorityHint: Private calculation, noticing and humor before action
dim.dialogueHint: Subtext, cadence, distinct speakers, no lecture speeches
dim.pacingHint: Breathing room per beat; short paragraphs; no walls
dim.hookHint: The ending pulls the reader into the next chapter
dim.payoffHint: At least one earned small win in the chapter
